title: Safety Alignment Can Be Not Superficial With Explicit Safety Signals
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety alignment against adversarial attacks. While it utilizes safety classifiers that categorize content based on ethical and moral violations (e.g., Llama3-Guard categories S1-S14) and models use ethical justifications in their refusal responses, the research objective is the evaluation of safety mechanisms rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning systems themselves.
